narrative: A frayed rope's end coiled on a property bench in the tiring-house. No dog. No collar. Daylight from a high slit, grey and cold. Size-pots and a rabbit-skin glue brush at the edge of the bench. No hand. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left the bench alone.

entities.name: the rope
entities.context: In photo: A rope's end on the bench
